confirmedGaps.gap: Limited external recognition in the Google Links sample
confirmedGaps.evidence: Nine reported links from two app-listing domains, all targeting the homepage. Boone and cleanup pages have no reported external links in this sample.
confirmedGaps.action: Seek genuine participant, community-group, business or local-publication references linking to the relevant existing Boone or cleanup URL. Do not fabricate partnerships or buy bulk links.
confirmedGaps.expectedBenefit: Discovery and relevant third-party context; ranking impact is not established.
confirmedGaps.verification: Verify each referring page and target URL live; monitor GSC links and nonbrand landing-page impressions over later 28-day periods.

confirmedGaps.gap: Locality labels are absent from report pages outside the sole approved Boone community

evidence.exampleTitle: Trash at Beacon Heights Trail Head — Completed cleanup | Litterbugs
evidence.bodyObservation: No city/state location line on this live page.
evidence.sourceCause: public-report-share.ts derives locality from the approved community; public-report-content.ts omits locality otherwise.

confirmedGaps.action: Add verified broad city/state or locality independently of whether a full community hub exists. Keep exact coordinates protected; never guess the locality.
confirmedGaps.expectedBenefit: Clearer local relevance and geographic context; no traffic increase quantified.
confirmedGaps.verification: Compare visible locality, title and description against verified report geography and re-fetch the updated page.

confirmedGaps.gap: Homepage does not directly link to the Boone community hub

evidence.presentInstead: Generic Communities navigation, individual report links and Boone-centered map URLs.

confirmedGaps.action: Add a descriptive Boone cleanup opportunities link beside the existing homepage map or cleanup content.
confirmedGaps.expectedBenefit: A direct crawlable route to the local landing page, useful to visitors. This is not an orphan-page defect.
confirmedGaps.verification: Inspect the homepage HTML for an anchor to /communities/us/nc/boone; verify the target stays indexed.

confirmedGaps.gap: Long generated report search titles can bury the place and cleanup purpose

evidence.example: Trash all over woods behind New River Grill/New Market Center — Litter report near Boone, North Carolina | Litterbugs
evidence.metricCaveat: Tool pixel-width thresholds are review heuristics, not Google limits or proven causes of poor rankings.

confirmedGaps.action: Use concise factual search titles, preserving original user report titles on the page. Example for the existing cemetery result: Winkler Cemetery cleanup in Boone, NC | Litterbugs.
confirmedGaps.expectedBenefit: Clearer search-result text and less likelihood of truncating local context; ranking or CTR gains not quantified.
confirmedGaps.verification: Re-fetch metadata after editing and later inspect Google search appearance; Google can rewrite displayed titles.

alreadyPresent: Boone hub with five local resources and guidance
Standalone completed cleanup pages with original photos, dates, public participants and recorded removal amounts
Internal links between directories, Boone and individual reports
Self-canonical metadata and basic Organization/WebSite structured data; Boone breadcrumbs

excludedFromFixList.item: Bulk missing-page, blocked-indexing or broken-sitemap diagnosis
excludedFromFixList.reason: All 49 sitemap URLs respond; eight focused URL Inspection snapshots pass. Do not extrapolate eight snapshots into all-URL indexing.

excludedFromFixList.item: Canonical-outside-head warnings treated as blanket defects
excludedFromFixList.reason: Next.js streams dynamic metadata. Focused Google snapshots recognize report canonicals and indexed status; no indexing failure established from this warning.

excludedFromFixList.item: Thin-content classification from crawler word counts
excludedFromFixList.reason: Broad crawl extraction repeatedly retained the Please wait fallback. Independent live full-response parsing found actual page content. Its two-word counts are invalid evidence of thin pages.

excludedFromFixList.item: Noindex and duplicate-metadata warnings on login/map/filter/app-link variants
excludedFromFixList.reason: These include intentional utility controls and canonical aliases; not all crawler warnings are product defects.

excludedFromFixList.item: A second cemetery story page or mass town-page generation
excludedFromFixList.reason: Existing cleanup stories already provide the evidence. Verify locality and useful activity before proposing more pages.
